ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_kl_divergence_001_advantage
ir.intuition: A pairwise KL divergence loss that first aggregates the weighted KL divergences per instance before averaging across the batch, maintaining the same probabilistic alignment but changing the aggregation structure from mean over pairs to mean over instances of summed weighted losses.
ir.pseudocode:
p = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
target = sigmoid(advantage_w - advantage_l)
kl = KL_divergence(target || p)
weighted_kl = weight * kl
per_instance_sum = sum(weighted_kl per instance)
final_loss = mean(per_instance_sum)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']
    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    
    p = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    target = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l))
    
    epsilon = 1e-7
    p_clamped = ops.clamp(p, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
    target_clamped = ops.clamp(target, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
    term1 = ops.mul(target_clamped, ops.log(ops.div(target_clamped, p_clamped)))
    term2 = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(target_clamped), target_clamped),
                     ops.log(ops.div(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), target_clamped), ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), p_clamped))))
    kl = ops.add(term1, term2)
    if weight is not None:
        weighted_kl = ops.mul(kl, weight)
    else:
        weighted_kl = kl
    # Sum weighted kl per instance (assuming batch has 'instance_idx')
    instance_idx = batch.get('instance_idx', None)
    if instance_idx is not None:
        # accumulate sum per unique instance_idx, then mean over unique indices
        unique_idx, inverse_indices = ops.unique(instance_idx, return_inverse=True)
        # scatter_add pattern using zeros_like and indexing
        sums_per_instance = ops.zeros_like(unique_idx, dtype=kl.dtype)
        sums_per_instance = ops.scatter_add(sums_per_instance, inverse_indices, weighted_kl)
        loss = ops.mean(sums_per_instance)
    else:
        loss = ops.mean(weighted_kl)
    return loss
